subject: Request: Quarterly invoicing + Net-60 pilot for Sunrise Healthcare
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Quarterly invoicing + Net-60 pilot for Sunrise Healthcare

Team,

Quick ask: Sunrise Healthcare (prospect turned ACV customer; ARR ~ $280k) is requesting quarterly invoicing aligned to their fiscal quarters and Net-60 payment terms. Theyre proposing a 2-year commitment and are willing to sign an amendment and provide a PO. The value and strategic signal (healthcare reference customer in NE region) make this attractive, but terms are non-standard for Redwood.

Why they ask:
- They operate on a quarterly procurement cadence tied to grant cycles
- Treasury prefers one invoice per quarter to simplify reconciliation

What they propose:
- Quarterly invoicing (4 invoices/year) on calendar quarters
- Net-60 from invoice date
- 2-year term; willing to accept renewal auto-renew with 90-day opt-out

Risk mitigations we discussed with them:
- They will issue a PO per quarter before invoicing
- Customer can provide ACH authorization; happy to have invoice remittance via ACH
- Theyre open to a small processing surcharge if needed (we have not asked for one formally)

Attachments: draft MOU with a proposed clause for quarterly invoicing (sunrise_MOU_v3.pdf). I also ran a quick credit pull and attached the snapshot for Jonas review (credit_snapshot_Sunrise_0527.pdf).

Requested: Exec signoff to approve this as a pilot (Net-60 + quarterly invoicing) for Sunrise with conditions to be set by Finance and Legal. If approved, next steps are: legal to sign amendment, procurement to send PO, and operations to onboard billing cadence.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345 (DEAL-2027-0421)

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mobile: (415) 555-0189
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Quarterly invoicing + Net-60 pilot for Sunrise Healthcare

Rachel —

Thanks for the detail and the attachments. A few items Finance/RevOps need to sign off on before we can take to Legal and Execs:

1) Credit profile: the snapshot you attached helps; we need a 12-month AR aging history and confirmation whether theyve had late payments with other SaaS vendors. If score is below our threshold we will require either an initial deposit or a confirmed PO with payment terms clarified.
2) Revenue recognition: quarterly invoicing with Net-60 will delay cash; we need Marcus to confirm that this cadence is acceptable for revenue recognition and cash flow forecasts.
3) PO cadence: confirm that Procurement will issue PO at least 10 business days prior to invoice date to avoid billing delays.

I attached the credit snapshot you included and added a short checklist (see attached credit_snapshot_Sunrise_0527.pdf). Can you loop in the procurement contact at Sunrise? Also include Legal when we have the final MOU language.

If credit looks green, Im OK to push this to Marissa for conditional exec approval.

- Jonas
Jonas Weber
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Soto <elena@sunrisehealthcare.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@sunrisehealthcare.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Quarterly invoicing + Net-60 pilot for Sunrise Healthcare

Rachel, Jonas —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the draft MOU. We can confirm the following from our side:

- Procurement will issue a PO per quarter. We can commit to sending the PO 15 days before each quarter invoice date.
- Treasury is comfortable with Net-60 on the invoice date; they asked for one clarification: will Redwood accept electronic remittance by ACH and email sent to accounts@redwood.com?
- For the initial invoice, our CFO has asked for a short confirmation that there will be no changes to SLA or data access under this amendment.

Ill copy our procurement lead on the thread. If you can share the DocuSign link for the amendment, procurement will prioritize it.

Best,
Elena Soto
Director of IT Procurement
Sunrise Healthcare
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Quarterly invoicing + Net-60 pilot for Sunrise Healthcare

Team —

I looked through the draft MOU (sunrise_MOU_v3.pdf). Legal is ok in principle with quarterly invoicing and Net-60, but we need a short amendment that does the following:

1) Explicitly states invoicing cadence and Net-60 payment term with invoice date as the start of the clock.
2) Adds a clause requiring a valid PO prior to each invoice and confirms acceptance of ACH electronic remittance to accounts@redwood.com.
3) Includes a 30-day cure period for any disputed fees and states that disputes do not delay payment for undisputed amounts.
4) Limits the pilot to 12 months after signature, with the option to extend by mutual written agreement.

Please also confirm whether we should propose a small processing fee or require the initial quarter to be paid within 30 days if the credit profile is marginal. Once Jonas confirms credit we will draft the amendment language and circulate for signature.

- Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: Conditional pilot approval for Sunrise Healthcare

All —

Having reviewed the context, I am approving a conditional pilot for quarterly invoicing + Net-60 for Sunrise Healthcare, subject to the following conditions:

1) Marcus signs off on the credit and cashflow impact. If the credit snapshot is below our internal threshold, require either an upfront deposit equal to the first invoice or a confirmed irrevocable PO before first billing.
2) Legal (Neha) to prepare the 12-month amendment per her note, including the dispute cure clause and PO requirement.
3) No changes to SLA or data access; amendment cannot alter existing security terms.
4) Finance to monitor collections closely for the first two quarters and report any late payments immediately.

If Marcus confirms credit and the amendment is prepared, Rachel proceed to send the DocuSign and get procurement to return the PO. Marcus, please confirm on the credit/cashflow item. Jonas, continue to support billing cadence.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@sunrisehealthcare.com>, Procurement <procurement@sunrisehealthcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Quarterly invoicing + Net-60 pilot for Sunrise Healthcare — next steps

Elena —

Thanks, and appreciated. Per Marissas conditional approval, next steps and summary for clarity:

Agreed pilot terms (summary):
- Quarterly invoicing aligned to calendar quarters; invoice issued on first business day of quarter.
- Net-60 from invoice date.
- Pilot length: 12 months from amendment signature.
- Customer will issue a PO at least 10 business days prior to invoice date.
- ACH remittance to accounts@redwood.com accepted.

Action items:
- Legal (Neha) will circulate a short amendment today reflecting these items.
- Marcus to confirm credit approval or request an initial deposit before first invoice.
- Rachel to send DocuSign once amendment is finalized.
- Elena/procurement to confirm PO cadence and send the first PO for Q3 invoice.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/eqn/abc123 (will contain final amendment)

Attachments: updated MOU attached (sunrise_MOU_v3.pdf). Jonas will coordinate billing calendar with your procurement team after signature.

Thanks all — Ill follow up when Neha shares the amendment.

Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
